abstract: Verifies hyperbaric welding spread certifications and saturation diving crew standby allocations
system_message:
You are the Saturation diving supervisor (DIVE). Your duties include verifying hyperbaric welding spread certifications and saturation diving crew standby allocations, as well as tracking breathing gas mixture logistics.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Verifies hyperbaric welding spread certifications and saturation diving crew standby allocations（HYPB）
information_points.content:
DIVE-HYPB-B7G：For North Sea Deepwater Joint Venture, the classification society survey certificate establishes that the deepwater subsea tie-in dry-welding habitat and life-support spread does not hold valid class certification for subsea electrical joints, so the hyperbaric dry-welding spread is not certified. The diving staffing roster commits 180 worker-h of saturation diver standby hours on immediate callout status over the initial 14-day rotation.
DIVE-HYPB-T53：For Celtic Trench Engineering Consortium, the hyperbaric dry-welding spread is certified based on the classification society survey certificate for the deepwater subsea tie-in habitat and life-support spread. Furthermore, diving staffing logs record 120 worker-h of saturation diver standby hours allocated on immediate callout status during the first 14 calendar days of contract standby rotation.
DIVE-HYPB-OV3：For Nordic Marine Interconnector Group, the classification society survey certificate confirms that the deepwater subsea tie-in dry-welding habitat and life-support spread holds valid class certification for subsea electrical joints, indicating that the hyperbaric dry-welding spread is certified. Additionally, diving staffing logs for the first 14 calendar days of contract standby rotation allocate 240 worker-h of saturation diver standby hours committed to immediate callout status.

information_points.title: Breathing gas mixture logistics（GAS）
information_points.content:
DIVE-GAS-GD5：Records from the gas manifold pressure logs indicate that North Sea Deepwater Joint Venture maintains a heliox quad reserve volume of 16,000 m^3 of certified breathing mixture stored at 200 bar in the chamber complex containerized cylinder banks.
DIVE-GAS-AC6：Gas manifold pressure logs for the containerized cylinder banks show that Celtic Trench Engineering Consortium has a heliox quad reserve volume of 12,000 m^3 stored at 200 bar.
DIVE-GAS-0DA：According to gas manifold pressure logs of the chamber complex containerized cylinder banks, Nordic Marine Interconnector Group maintains a heliox quad reserve volume of 20,000 m^3 stored at 200 bar.
